title.zh: PLC 检测与分拣流水线

summary.zh: 使用两台西门子 S7-1200 PLC 与触摸屏，完成物料搬运、检测、分类和故障报警的完整产线。
summary.en: A complete material handling, inspection, sorting and fault-alarm line built with two Siemens S7-1200 PLCs and an HMI.

resumeSummary.zh: 通过两个西门子 S7-1200 PLC 与昆仑通态触摸屏，采集多个传感器信息并控制电磁阀、变频器、步进电机等执行机构，完成物料的搬运、检测、分类全流程。基于状态机编程完成顺序控制，基于看门狗实现动作超时报警。
resumeSummary.en: Built a full material handling, inspection and sorting process with two Siemens S7-1200 PLCs and an MCGS touchscreen, collecting multiple sensor signals and controlling solenoid valves, a variable-frequency drive and stepper motors. Implemented sequential control with a state machine and action-timeout alarms with watchdog logic.

challenge.zh: 多个传感器与气动、电机执行机构需要跨 PLC 协同，顺序动作既要稳定运行，也要在单步超时或传感器异常时及时报警。
challenge.en: Multiple sensors, pneumatic actuators and motors had to coordinate across two PLCs while detecting step timeouts and sensor faults safely.

zh: 使用两台 S7-1200 PLC 和昆仑通态触摸屏组织控制与监控。
采集多种传感器并控制电磁阀、变频器和步进电机。
采用状态机完成顺序控制，并以看门狗机制实现动作超时报警。
en: Organized control and monitoring with two S7-1200 PLCs and an MCGS HMI.
Read multiple sensors and controlled solenoid valves, a variable-frequency drive and a stepper motor.
Implemented sequential control with a state machine and action-timeout alarms with watchdog logic.

zh: 使用 SCL 与 LAD 完成 PLC 程序设计。
负责双 PLC 通信、整线调试与故障排查。
完成各类传感器和执行机构接线。
en: Programmed the PLCs using both SCL and LAD.
Led dual-PLC communication, line commissioning and troubleshooting.
Wired the sensors and actuators across the line.

outcome.zh: 完成从物料搬运、检测、分类到超时报警的全流程搭建与联调。
outcome.en: Completed and commissioned the full process from material transport and inspection to sorting and timeout alarms.

alt.zh: 带传感器、气动元件和控制柜的 PLC 分拣流水线
alt.en: PLC sorting line with sensors, pneumatic components and control wiring

caption.zh: 检测、分拣与控制系统联调
caption.en: Integrated inspection, sorting and control system
